title: Indonesian political rhetoric targeting neighbours aimed at distracting from domestic pressures
paragraphs: Indonesian political rhetoric targeting neighbours aimed at distracting from domestic pressures

Sharp remarks by Indonesian political figures reflect domestic frustration, economic nationalism and political posturing, said analysts who also cautioned against reading too much into the criticism of Malaysia and Singapore.

SINGAPORE: Recent remarks by current and former Indonesian political figures targeting neighbouring countries amid the transboundary haze appear to be driven by “domestic political frustrations” and posturing rather than signalling a shift in Indonesia’s approach towards its neighbours, analysts said.
